titles.title: opening the board creates one editor-tab panel with a CSP-locked document and posts the snapshot's items with its taken-at time
when the earlier refresh answers after the later one, only the later snapshot is posted
a client that throws synchronously ends the refresh as failed instead of leaving the board loading
an answer or timeout that arrives after the panel is closed is neither posted nor logged
the board document inserts text only through textContent and posts only board up-messages
the board view renders titles and notices containing markup and script as literal text
the board controls post only board up-messages, the scope control lists every epic, and an empty selection says nothing matches
show-more reveals the next page of one column, and a new search resets paging
an item with an unknown stage is left off the board and logged once per refresh
a selection change that cannot be rendered keeps the previous board and is logged
a refresh whose loading state cannot be shown is logged and asks the daemon nothing
switching views posts the selected view with the same selection, and switching back keeps the board page
a follow link naming an item that is not on the board is ignored and logged
the epic rollup and issue view render as text, and their tabs and links post only set-view and select-item
a logger that throws never leaves the board loading or stops a refresh
opening a story reads its plan once per snapshot and shows the dependencies when it arrives
a review-view record opens in the review pane and a build record opens read-only from the daemon as text
a failed, malformed or stale plan read leaves the details standing with a notice
the details pane renders as text and its controls post only select-item, close-details and open-evidence
a narrow pane stacks the columns into one list grouped by stage, and no rule hides a card, badge or warning
a selection and a settled refresh are each announced once, and loading, superseded answers, reloads and other intents announce nothing
every card is focusable and opens with Enter or Space, arrows move between cards, and closing the details returns focus to the card
when the card that opened the details is gone, closing them focuses the shown view's tab
the announce region is the only live region and is set once per message
density is restored from the webview state, saved on change and mirrored to the host, and both densities render every badge, warning and label
the refresh announcement text is unchanged after statusView takes now
an answer to a superseded refresh is dropped and nothing from it is applied
empty, unavailable, failed and partial snapshots each give their own status, a partial snapshot still lists every item, and a snapshot with no items but unreadable records is partial, not empty
a failed refresh keeps the last snapshot as stale with the failure and its time
a refresh keeps the selection, and clears a selected item that is gone with a notice

statusView panel kinds — empty, unavailable, refresh-failed (stale with a shown snapshot, retry action), partial with affected entries from store notices and the unreadable count; freshnessLabel phrasing and NaN fallback
